title: Everything in the car
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Wednesday, week two. A classmate asks what's in the box on the Datsun's back seat. 'Everything.' The novel rides to Newport every day and never comes in.

panels.composition: The Newport lot. The Datsun. A cardboard box on the back seat, taped. A CLASSMATE at the window. WOOD getting out.
props: a taped box on the back seat

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a rusted small car in a college lot with a taped cardboard box on its back seat, a classmate peering in the window, a young man getting out

panels.composition: The box through the glass. Pages, a rubber band, the top page face up: a title in the display face, unreadable, and page one.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up through a car window of a cardboard box of manuscript pages held by a rubber band, a title on the top page unreadable
image.notes: The novel. Title reserved. It rides in the car through 2011.

panels.composition: The classmate, not asking further. Wood locking the door. Twice.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man locking a car door twice while a classmate loses interest

panels.composition: The car, locked, in Lot C. The box in the back seat. Wood walking to the building. The box stays. Every day.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man walking away from a locked rusted car in a lot with a cardboard box visible on its back seat, no words

art.line: brush-pen now — the weekday deadline teaches the hand to commit; still xeroxed, still black and white
art.paper: the college paper's newsprint; the digest's quarter-letter xerox

notes: 'Everything.' The novel rides in and never comes in.
